lessons.L1: CASH is not a symbol; excluded from turnover, concentration, drop-one
lessons.L2: execution cost charged exactly once per fill; no sidecar repetition
lessons.L3: one named turnover convention: sum(abs(delta_weight)) non-CASH (ADJ-5)
lessons.L4: canonical digest hashes exact artifact bytes, never a wrapper (A7T-B1)
lessons.L5: observed increments once when a score exists; replay increments neither; A1 alone appends the canonical ledger
lessons.L6: SPY/sector beta is not alpha; raw PnL never overrides failed incremental alpha or a firing control
lessons.L7: a control that is rank-identical (or near-identical) to its anchor cannot identify anything - measure control-anchor collinearity BEFORE selection (V4 lesson: A4-H2/A5-H2/A6-H1 self-subsuming controls)
